brief.headline: Geran fuel-depot strikes surge; 209 Ukrainian drones claimed downed
brief.lead: Pro-Kremlin channels celebrated an intensified Geran drone campaign against Ukrainian fuel and gas infrastructure while touting a claimed 209-drone overnight air-defense haul, even as Ukrainian strikes hit Russian energy sites. Frontline mood stayed buoyant on reported gains in Dnipropetrovsk and around Konstantinovka.

developments.title: Geran strikes hammer Ukrainian fuel and gas infrastructure
developments.body: Channels claimed Geran-4/5 drones destroyed fuel depots in Kirovohrad and gas-distribution facilities in Kharkiv (including the Skvorcovskaya site), framing strikes as reaching a "new effectiveness level." All claims are channel/MoD-sourced and unconfirmed.

developments.title: Russia claims 209 Ukrainian drones downed overnight
developments.body: Multiple channels amplified an MoD claim of 209 drones destroyed over several regions, with Sevastopol reporting 29 shot down and minor debris damage. Ukrainian strikes still hit energy infrastructure in Zaporizhzhia and Kherson; the top post drew 553k views.

developments.title: Claimed advances at Bogodiarovka and Konstantinovka retreat
developments.body: Channels reported the 36th Guards brigade and Eastern/Vostok groups capturing Bogodiarovka in Dnipropetrovsk direction and a claimed Ukrainian retreat from Konstantinovka. Rybar claimed a fourth settlement seized along the Gaichur river. All unconfirmed.

developments.title: Armed Gazprom tanker framed as shadow-fleet deterrent
developments.body: Channels highlighted the LNG tanker Marshal Vasilevsky fitted with Kord machine guns in the Gulf of Finland, citing a purported NATO strategist to argue arming shadow-fleet vessels deters European boarding operations.

developments.title: Belgorod plans eight volunteer BARS air-defense battalions
developments.body: Two Majors reported a Belgorod deputy governor announcing plans to form eight volunteer BARS battalions for air defense (135k views), part of a cluster of mobilisation-related posts flagged by the monitor.

developments.title: Putin rejects Ukrainian ceasefire terms
developments.body: Two Majors relayed Putin calling Ukrainian ceasefire proposals unacceptable, describing Kyiv's wish for a four-region demarcation and a mutual halt to strikes.

narrative_watch.title: Geran drones as war-winning precision tool
narrative_watch.body: Channels increasingly frame Geran strikes as having crossed a threshold of "new effectiveness," systematically degrading Ukrainian fuel, gas and drone-storage capacity to preempt strikes on Russia.

narrative_watch.title: Ukraine-cartel narcotics conspiracy
narrative_watch.body: Two channels amplified Russian-intelligence claims that Ukraine coordinates with Mexican drug cartels for financing, mercenaries and narcotics transit to Europe — an unverified delegitimization frame.

narrative_watch.title: Ukrainian drone strikes dismissed as symbolic
narrative_watch.body: Kotsnews framed Ukrainian drone strikes on Moscow as "symbolic psychological warfare" targeting morale, softening the impact of incoming attacks.

mood_lines.text: Uniformly triumphant (net +100); 16 posts celebrate Geran strikes on fuel, gas and drone-storage sites as newly precise and decisive.
Still negative (net -33) but sharply improved on the 209-drone intercept claim; unease persists over FPVs reaching Kharkiv outskirts.
Confident (net +64) on claimed Bogodiarovka capture and Konstantinovka retreat, with only cautious drone-warfare analysis tempering the tone.
Negative (net -30) across 23 posts: Baltic drone factories, Polish submarines, Estonian rhetoric and shadow-fleet boarding threats.
Positive net (+18) but down sharply; mobilisation and mobile-fire-group posts inject friction beneath Beloussov's anti-drone messaging.
Uniformly negative (net -100) but low volume; rare jab at military planning over failure to keep striking Voznesensk airfield.

flag_texts.title: Strikes on Ukraine sentiment maxes out (+42)
flag_texts.body: All 16 posts on strikes were positive, pushing net to +100 as channels lionized the Geran campaign against fuel depots in Kirovohrad and gas facilities in Kharkiv.

flag_texts.title: Ukraine-strikes mood rebounds (+56)
flag_texts.body: Still net-negative (-33), the topic swung upward as channels foregrounded the claimed 209-drone intercept and mobile-fire-group successes rather than damage.

flag_texts.title: Russia-internal mood drops (-57)
flag_texts.body: Net fell to +18 as posts on threatened mobile fire groups, missing medical kits and mobilisation offset upbeat coverage of Beloussov's anti-drone strategy.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation chatter across three channels
flag_texts.body: Four posts touched mobilisation, including Belgorod's plan for eight volunteer BARS air-defense battalions and warnings about undertrained, under-equipped mobile fire groups needing first-aid kits.

flag_texts.title: No criticism of Putin
flag_texts.body: The watchlist recorded zero posts directly criticizing Putin; the day's limited criticism targeted military planning and government intelligence framing instead.
